content:
Industrials businesses quietly power the physical things we depend on, from cars and homes to e-commerce infrastructure. Unfortunately, this role also comes with a demand profile tethered to the ebbs and flows of the broader economy, and the industry is currently lagging as its six-month return of 4.7% has trailed the S&P 500's 14% gain.

Despite the lackluster result, a few diamonds in the rough can produce earnings growth no matter what, and we started StockStory to help you find them. On that note, here is one resilient industrials stock at the top of our wish list and two we're steering clear of.

A pioneer in the field of center pivot and lateral move irrigation, Lindsay (NYSE:LNN) provides a variety of proprietary water management and road infrastructure products and services.

Flat sales over the last two years suggest it must find different ways to grow during this cycle

Falling earnings per share over the last two years has some investors worried as stock prices ultimately follow EPS over the long term

Diminishing returns on capital suggest its earlier profit pools are drying up

Lindsay is trading at $123.42 per share, or 22.3x forward P/E. Read our free research report to see why you should think twice about including LNN in your portfolio, it's free .

Gates Industrial Corporation (GTES)

Helping create one of the most memorable moments for the iconic "Jurassic Park" film, Gates (NYSE:GTES) offers power transmission and fluid transfer equipment for various industries.

Organic revenue growth fell short of our benchmarks over the past two years and implies it may need to improve its products, pricing, or go-to-market strategy

Earnings growth over the last two years fell short of the peer group average as its EPS only increased by 5.2% annually

ROIC of 6.9% reflects management's challenges in identifying attractive investment opportunities

Gates Industrial Corporation's stock price of $25.95 implies a valuation ratio of 13.8x forward P/E. If you're considering GTES for your portfolio, see our FREE research report to learn more .

Holding a Guinness World Record for creating the world's largest gasket, Enpro (NYSE:NPO) designs, manufactures, and sells products used for machinery in various industries.

Offerings are difficult to replicate at scale and result in a stellar gross margin of 41.1%

Earnings per share grew by 15.9% annually over the last two years and trumped its peers

Robust free cash flow margin of 12.8% gives it many options for capital deployment

At $296.94 per share, Enpro trades at 28.6x forward P/E. Is now the right time to buy? Find out in our full research report, it's free .

chineseTitle: 1 只适合长期投资者的工业股票，2 只我们回避的股票
chineseSummary: 工业企业悄悄地为我们所依赖的物质事物提供动力，从汽车、房屋到电子商务基础设施。不幸的是，这一角色的需求状况也与整体经济的潮起潮落有关，而且该行业目前表现落后，其 6 个月回报率为 4.7%，落后于标准普尔 500 指数 14% 的涨幅。
chineseContent:
工业企业悄悄地为我们所依赖的物质事物提供动力，从汽车、房屋到电子商务基础设施。不幸的是，这一角色的需求状况也与整体经济的潮起潮落有关，而且该行业目前表现落后，其 6 个月回报率为 4.7%，落后于标准普尔 500 指数 14% 的涨幅。

尽管结果平淡无奇，但无论如何，一些未加工的钻石可以带来收益增长，我们启动了 StockStory 来帮助您找到它们。在这一点上，我们的愿望清单中排名第一的是一只具有弹性的工业股，而我们则避开了两只。

Lindsay（纽约证券交易所代码：LNN）是中心枢轴和横向移动灌溉领域的先驱，提供各种专有的水管理和道路基础设施产品和服务。

过去两年的销售持平表明，该公司必须在这个周期中找到不同的增长方式

过去两年每股收益的下降令一些投资者感到担忧，因为从长远来看，股价最终会跟随每股收益的变化

资本回报率递减表明其早期的利润池正在枯竭

Lindsay 的交易价格为每股 123.42 美元，即 22.3 倍远期市盈率。请阅读我们的免费研究报告，了解为什么您在将 LNN 纳入您的投资组合时应该三思而后行，它是免费的。

盖茨工业公司 (GTES)

盖茨（纽约证券交易所股票代码：GTES）为各个行业提供动力传输和流体输送设备，帮助创造标志性的“侏罗纪公园”电影中最难忘的时刻之一。

过去两年的有机收入增长低于我们的基准，这意味着它可能需要改进其产品、定价或上市策略

过去两年的盈利增长低于同行平均水平，每股收益每年仅增长 5.2%

6.9% 的投资回报率反映了管理层在寻找有吸引力的投资机会方面面临的挑战

盖茨工业公司的股价为 25.95 美元，意味着其估值率为 13.8 倍的远期市盈率。如果您正在考虑将 GTES 作为您的投资组合，请参阅我们的免费研究报告以了解更多信息。

Enpro (NYSE:NPO) 拥有创造世界上最大垫圈的吉尼斯世界纪录，设计、制造和销售用于各行业机械的产品。

产品难以大规模复制，毛利率高达 41.1%

过去两年每股收益每年增长15.9%，领先于同行

12.8% 的强劲自由现金流利润率为其提供了多种资本部署选择

Enpro 的股价为每股 296.94 美元，预期市盈率为 28.6 倍。现在是购买的合适时机吗？请在我们的完整研究报告中找到答案，它是免费的。
